title: PPF and PPFD photon-flow schematic
author: THC Educational Content Production
alt: Fixture emitting total photosynthetic photon flux PPF in micromoles per second toward a canopy measurement grid, where PPFD is recorded in micromoles per square meter per second. Some photons miss the canopy.
caption: PPF is total fixture photon output; PPFD is local delivery per area. The schematic is conceptual, with no measured distribution or recommended target.
sources: ANSI/ASABE S640: Quantities and Units of Electromagnetic Radiation for Plants (Photosynthetic Organisms)
Plant Lighting Efficiency and Efficacy: μmol/J and PPFD measurement context
